text: 欧派家居公告，公司此前审议通过回购股份预案，拟使用不低于人民币1亿元（含）且不超过人民币2亿元（含）的自有资金或自筹资金，以不超过人民币46.25元/股（含）的价格回购公司股份，回购股份将全部予以注销并减少注册资本。2026年11月12日，公司以集中竞价交易方式首次回购公司股份34.18万股，占公司总股本的比例为0.056%，回购最高成交价格29.65元/股，最低成交价格28.95元/股，已支付总金额999.8万元（不含交易费用）。
text_en: Oppein Home announced that the company previously approved a share repurchase plan, intending to use no less than 100 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 200 million yuan (inclusive) of its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase company shares at a price of no more than 46.25 yuan per share (inclusive), and all repurchased shares will be canceled and registered capital reduced. On November 12, 2026, the company repurchased 341,800 shares for the first time through centralized bidding, accounting for 0.056% of the company's total share capital. The highest repurchase price was 29.65 yuan per share, and the lowest was 28.95 yuan per share, with a total amount paid of 9.998 million yuan (excluding transaction fees).
